about: Sai Urja Indo Ventures provides operation and maintenance (O&M) services to power plants and other industries, covering electrical, C&I and mechanical maintenance, coal handling/MGR/BTG operations, housekeeping, overhauls and manpower supply. It is based in Chandrapur, Maharashtra and served 15 plant locations with about 2,058 deployed personnel in FY26. Revenue was about Rs 85 crore in FY26 and the order book was about Rs 159.67 crore as of June 15, 2026.
sector: Power plant O&M and industrial services

objects.purpose: General corporate purposes (amount to be finalised in Prospectus)

promoters.background: Both promoters are also the Promoter Selling Shareholders, each selling 1,89,600 shares in the offer for sale. Harsh Mittal is Managing Director. Promoters have given personal guarantees for company loans.

concentration.note: Top 1 client was 74.77% of FY26 revenue (70.49% FY25, 49.99% FY24); top 5 95.46%; top 10 99.97%. PSU contracts were 92.27% of FY26 revenue.

litigation_note: No outstanding proceedings against the Company, Promoters, Directors and KMP per the RHP; contingent liabilities of Rs 1.11 crore at Mar-26.
strengths: Diversified O&M services across maintenance, operations (MGR, CHP, BTG) and manpower/housekeeping for power and other industries.
Revenue grew from Rs 45.62 crore in FY24 to Rs 85.11 crore in FY26, a 36.59% two-year CAGR.
PAT rose to Rs 4.24 crore in FY26 from Rs 1.37 crore in FY24, with PAT margin improving from 3.01% to 4.98%.
Order book of Rs 159.67 crore as of June 15, 2026, about 1.9 times FY26 revenue.
Repeat orders from existing clients make up 99.65% of revenue from operations.
High reported return ratios: ROCE 50.66% and RoNW 42.44% in FY26.
Current ratio improved from 0.96 to 1.54 over FY24 to FY26.
Experienced promoter-led team with a sizable workforce of about 2,058 people.

risks.title: Extreme customer concentration
risks.detail: Top client contributed 74.77% of FY26 revenue (70.49% FY25) and top 10 clients 99.97%. Loss of one client would hit the business badly.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on PSU contracts
risks.detail: PSU contracts were 92.27% of FY26 revenue (91.13% FY25, 81.28% FY24); future awards are not assured.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 0.95 crore in FY26 and Rs 2.10 crore in FY25 due to working capital build-up; trade receivables are Rs 10.52 crore.

risks.title: High working capital needs and rising debt
risks.detail: Borrowings grew from Rs 2.15 crore in FY24 to Rs 7.18 crore in FY26; Rs 6.60 crore of IPO money will repay loans and Rs 8 crore funds working capital.

risks.title: Order book may not convert to revenue
risks.detail: Order book of Rs 159.67 crore includes Rs 62.65 crore already executed; only Rs 97.02 crore is yet to be executed and orders can be delayed or cancelled.

risks.title: Related party dealings and promoter guarantees
risks.detail: Transactions with directors and promoter-linked firms include Rs 273.50 lakh director loan taken and repaid in FY26 and Rs 150.26 lakh reimbursements to an associate firm; promoters guarantee company loans.

risks.title: Statutory filing delays and compliance lapses
risks.detail: Delayed GST, ESIC and other statutory payments/returns in past years, plus several late ROC filings with additional fees paid.

risks.title: Thin margins and small size
risks.detail: EBITDA margin is only 7.65% with a fixed-price contract model; the company is small (revenue about Rs 85 crore) and the offer is a small SME issue with promoters retaining 65.65%.

notes: FY26 restated consolidated, amounts converted from Rs lakhs to Rs crore. Price band, issue size in Rs and P/E are blank in the RHP. Balance sheet and cash flow tables were garbled in text and reconstructed (borrowings = current + non-current, matches reported debt/equity). Total offer is 22,08,000 shares (28.91% of post-offer capital). Promoter post-offer holding computed from the offer-for-sale table (31.33% + 34.32%). Reservation percentages are the standard SEBI split of the net offer (QIB up to 50% with up to 60% of that to anchors, NII not less than 15%, retail not less than 35%); a 2,16,000 share market maker portion is excluded. Peer Lakshya Powertech is the only listed peer. Revenue by segment: Maintenance Rs 59.90 crore, Operations Rs 13.38 crore, Other Rs 11.83 crore in FY26.
